newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - OCT 8.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - OCT 8.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:

- As a new development of the privatisation scandal, the Highest Public Prosecutor ordered an inquiry in the case of Marta Tocsik for alleged unlawful legal practice and against unknown persons for the misuse of state property.
- The spokesman of the foreign ministry said Hungary's privatisation scandal was mostly shrugged off abroad.
- The Parliament discussed plans about changing the system of subsidies to families bringing up children and about the taxation of agricultural small producers.
- Planned changes in the system of social security contributions may not result in the reduction of the tax burdens on people, speakers said in the Parliament.
